notes: Owner approved UI/UX closeout and entry into Heartbeat planning on 2026-09-08. Preserve the ratified product direction and remain planning until scope, design and execution artifacts are reviewed. No production implementation or automatic inclusion of deferred permission work is authorized by this planning checkpoint. On 2026-09-11 the owner requested a new development task; the linked companion-initiative-implementation child now owns the consolidated design, ordered implementation children and full acceptance map. This task preserves discovery and ratified requirements.
